source_refs.note: Exercise 6.5, Question 19 (book page 211); answer key PDF 308.

blocks.prompt: 19. Find the equations of the tangents to the hyperbola \(7x^2 - 3y^2 = 105\) that pass through the point \((3, 1)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal bilkul Example 28 jaisa hai: bahar ke ek point se hyperbola par tangents khenchne hain.
Rule kaunsa? Slope \(m\) wala tangent \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) (jo tangency condition \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\) se aata hai).
Find kya karna hai? Woh tangents jo \((3, 1)\) se guzrein.
Plan: equation ko standard form mein layenge, point rakh kar \(m\) ki equation banayenge, \(m\) ki do values nikalenge, aur har \(m\) ke liye sahi sign chunenge.
Bahar ke point se aam taur par do tangents bante hain, is liye do jawab ki tawaqqo rakhiye.
steps:
Diya gaya: hyperbola \(7x^2 - 3y^2 = 105\) aur point \((3, 1)\).
Maloom karna: \((3, 1)\) se guzarne wale tangents.
Tareeqa: Kitab ki tangency condition \(c^2 = a^2m^2 - b^2\) ke mutabiq har slope \(m\) ke do tangents \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) hote hain. Inhein \((3, 1)\) se guzarne par majboor karenge to \(m\) ki equation ban jayegi.

Standard form banayein
\[\dfrac{x^2}{15} - \dfrac{y^2}{35} = 1\]
\[a^2 = 15,\quad b^2 = 35\]
Kyun: Formula sirf standard form par lagta hai, is liye har term ko 105 se divide kiya: \(\frac{7}{105} = \frac{1}{15}\) aur \(\frac{3}{105} = \frac{1}{35}\).
Dhyan dein: \(a^2 = 7\) ya \(b^2 = 3\) lena ghalat hai; pehle right side ko 1 banana zaroori hai.

Slope \(m\) wala tangent
\[y = mx \pm \sqrt{15m^2 - 35}\]
Kyun: Formula \(y = mx \pm \sqrt{a^2m^2 - b^2}\) mein \(a^2 = 15\) aur \(b^2 = 35\) rakh diye.

Point \((3, 1)\) rakhein
\[1 = 3m \pm \sqrt{15m^2 - 35}\]
\[1 - 3m = \pm\sqrt{15m^2 - 35}\]
Kyun: Tangent \((3, 1)\) se guzarta hai, is liye \(x = 3\), \(y = 1\) us ki equation ko poora karte hain. Square karne se pehle square root ko akela ek taraf rakha, taake square karne se root poori tarah khatam ho jaye.

Square kar ke \(m\) nikalein
\[1 - 6m + 9m^2 = 15m^2 - 35\]
\[6m^2 + 6m - 36 = 0\]
\[m^2 + m - 6 = 0\]
\[(m - 2)(m + 3) = 0\]
\[m = 2 \text{ or } m = -3\]
Kyun: Left side \((1 - 3m)^2\) ko expand kiya. Saari terms ek taraf le jakar 6 se divide kiya, phir factorise kiya: \(-2\) aur \(3\) ka product \(-6\) aur jama \(1\) hai.

\(m = 2\) ke liye
\[y = 2x \pm \sqrt{60 - 35}\]
\[y = 2x \pm 5\]
\[x = 3:\ 2(3) - 5 = 1\;\checkmark\]
\[2(3) + 5 = 11 \neq 1\]
\[\text{Tangent: } y = 2x - 5\]
Kyun: \(15(4) = 60\), aur \(\sqrt{25} = 5\). Square karne se dono signs wapas aa gaye, lekin \((3, 1)\) sirf ek line par hai. Example 28 ki tarah dono check kiye: \(y = 2x - 5\) par \(x = 3\) se \(y = 1\) aata hai, doosri par 11.
Dhyan dein: Dono lines likh dena aam ghalti hai; jo point se na guzre woh tangent to hai, lekin hamara jawab nahi.

\(m = -3\) ke liye
\[y = -3x \pm \sqrt{135 - 35}\]
\[y = -3x \pm 10\]
\[x = 3:\ -9 + 10 = 1\;\checkmark\]
\[-9 - 10 = -19 \neq 1\]
\[\text{Tangent: } y = -3x + 10\]
Kyun: \(15(9) = 135\) aur \(\sqrt{100} = 10\). Phir wahi test: sirf \(y = -3x + 10\) point \((3, 1)\) se guzarti hai.

Tasdeeq: points of contact
\[(6, 7):\ 7(36) - 3(49) = 105\;\checkmark\]
\[42x - 21y = 105 \Rightarrow y = 2x - 5\;\checkmark\]
\[\left(\tfrac{9}{2}, -\tfrac{7}{2}\right):\ \tfrac{567}{4} - \tfrac{147}{4} = 105\;\checkmark\]
\[\tfrac{63}{2}x + \tfrac{21}{2}y = 105 \Rightarrow y = -3x + 10\;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Example 27 ke mutabiq point \((x_1, y_1)\) par tangent \(7x_1x - 3y_1y = 105\) hota hai. Dono points hyperbola par hain, aur in par bana tangent bilkul hamari lines deta hai. Matlab dono jawab pakke hain. Figure mein dekhiye: dono lines \(P(3, 1)\) se nikal kar right branch ko ek ek point par chhooti hain.

answer_figure.alt: The hyperbola 7 x squared minus 3 y squared equals 105 with dashed asymptotes; from the point P(3, 1) two tangent lines are drawn: y = 2x minus 5 touching the right branch at (6, 7) and y = minus 3x plus 10 touching it at (9/2, minus 7/2).
